```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Locate the Quarto project root
PROJECT_DIR = Path.cwd().resolve()

while not (PROJECT_DIR / "_quarto.yml").exists():
    if PROJECT_DIR == PROJECT_DIR.parent:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot find the Quarto project root")
    PROJECT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR.parent

sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from scripts.samples import show_samples

show_samples("VUMC")
```
